svg.aria-label: Grouped bars of median milliseconds for three loops with the JIT off and on. With the JIT on, 3.13 is 7% slower, 9% slower and 0.3% faster; 3.14 is 22% slower, 10% slower and 13% slower. One machine, 2 million iterations each.
